changes_made.explanation: Removed redundant/duplicate items and consolidated to most descriptive versions. The paper focuses on text generation for training data, not general text generation or data generation.

automatic_metrics: Semantic similarity via FastText nearest neighbor

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate metrics. The paper uses accuracy for sentiment classification and word similarity via nearest neighbors (using FastText) for semantic evaluation.
No LLMs were used as judges in this paper. The evaluation was done using traditional automatic metrics and the paper does not mention using any language models for evaluation purposes.
No human evaluation was conducted. The paper explicitly states that future work will involve qualitative evaluation, indicating human evaluation was not part of this study.

overall_notes: The paper presents a rule-based system for generating training data in Runyankore (a Bantu language) using CFG and pattern-based approaches. Evaluation was purely automatic using accuracy for sentiment classification and word similarity metrics. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy that needed consolidation.
